categories.main_business_segments: Great Wall Motor Company Limited primarily engages in the design, research and development, manufacturing, sales, and service of automobiles and automotive parts. Its product portfolio includes SUVs, sedans, pickup trucks, MPVs, and motorcycles, covering traditional internal combustion engines and new energy vehicles such as BEVs, PHEVs, and fuel cell vehicles. The company operates multiple brands including Haval, Tank, Wey, Ora, Great Wall Pickup, and Great Wall Soul, targeting various market segments from economy to high-end and off-road vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes intelligent and new energy vehicle technologies, including self-developed intelligent driving systems (Coffee Pilot Ultra), smart cockpit systems (Coffee OS 3), and RISC-V based automotive-grade MCU chips (Zijing M100). It has developed a comprehensive Hi4 hybrid technology family with multiple architectures (Hi4, Hi4-T, Hi4-Z) for different driving scenarios, and pursues diversified battery chemistries including ternary, lithium iron phosphate, sodium, and solid-state batteries. Production methods include flexible manufacturing lines shared by traditional and new energy vehicles, and global localized production bases with advanced digital and lean manufacturing practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including individual consumers and commercial users domestically in China and internationally. Its products cater to urban commuters, off-road enthusiasts, and high-end users, with a strong presence in the SUV, pickup, and new energy vehicle markets. Overseas markets include Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and the Middle East, with sales networks covering over 170 countries and regions. The company does not rely heavily on any single customer, with the top five customers accounting for less than 5% of total sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: Great Wall Motor operates primarily in China, with major manufacturing and R&D facilities located in Hebei, Tianjin, Chongqing, and other Chinese cities. It has expanded its global footprint with production bases in Thailand, Brazil, and CKD assembly plants in Ecuador, Pakistan, Malaysia, and Vietnam. The company’s sales network spans over 170 countries and regions worldwide, with significant growth in overseas sales, which accounted for approximately 45.41 million units in 2024, representing a 44.61% year-on-year increase.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an integrated automotive manufacturer with upstream, midstream, and downstream capabilities. It develops and produces core components such as powertrains, chassis, intelligent cockpit hardware, and software in-house, while also collaborating with over 500 ecosystem partners in AI, chip design, and connected vehicle technologies. It manages a vertically integrated supply chain to ensure stability, cost control, and quality, and extends its supply chain globally to support its international operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Great Wall Motor focuses strategically on intelligent new energy vehicles, off-road technology advancement, and global expansion. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 10 billion RMB spent in 2024, emphasizing intelligent driving, smart cockpits, AI data intelligence, and computing power. The company pursues innovation in hybrid architectures, battery technologies, and fuel cell systems, and aims to accelerate the adoption of intelligent driving products and expand its global product matrix. It also prioritizes sustainable development and green supply chain initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of vehicles and automotive parts, including traditional internal combustion engine vehicles and new energy vehicles. Additional revenue streams include sales of automotive components, molds, and provision of related services. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies related to its operations. Its revenue is geographically diversified between domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Great Wall Motor is positioned as a leading Chinese automotive manufacturer with a strong focus on SUVs and pickup trucks, holding nearly 50% domestic market share in pickups. It is recognized as a global SUV expert with over 9 million global users for its Haval brand. The company competes with other major Chinese and international automakers in the new energy and intelligent vehicle sectors, leveraging its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities and global expansion strategy to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Great Wall Motor achieved total revenue of approximately 202.2 billion RMB, representing a 16.73% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching about 12.69 billion RMB, up 80.76%. The company sold 1.234 million vehicles globally, including 454,000 units overseas (up 44.61%) and 322,000 new energy vehicles (up 25.65%). It maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets of over 217 billion RMB and continues to invest significantly in R&D and global production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Great Wall Motor emphasizes high-quality manufacturing, advanced intelligent and new energy technologies, and diversified product offerings tailored to various customer needs. Its unique value lies in its integrated intelligent ecosystem (Forest Ecosystem), leading hybrid and off-road technologies, and comprehensive global presence. The company focuses on delivering superior user experiences through continuous OTA updates, AI-powered smart cockpits, and robust intelligent driving systems, positioning itself as a technology-driven, customer-centric global automotive brand.
